messages.content: I have chest pain
I understand you're experiencing chest pain. I'm here to help. Is this a new issue that just started, or is this an ongoing problem you've had before with a prior diagnosis?
It's new, started about an hour ago
Thank you for clarifying. To help me better understand your situation, could you please tell me your age?
I'm 58 years old
Thank you. For medical documentation purposes, what is your biological sex?
Male
Thank you. Now let's gather more details about your chest pain. When did this start, and did it come on suddenly?
It started about an hour ago and came on suddenly while I was watching TV
Where exactly is the pain located?
It's in the center of my chest, kind of behind my breastbone
Does the pain move anywhere else?
Yes, it goes to my left arm and my jaw
Is the pain constant or does it come and go?
It's constant, hasn't let up since it started
How long does an episode last?
It's been going on for about an hour straight now
How would you describe the feeling or sensation?
It feels like pressure, like something heavy is sitting on my chest
What makes it worse?
It seems worse when I take a deep breath
What makes it better? Have you tried any treatment?
I tried taking some antacids but that didn't help at all
Does it happen at a specific time or only during certain activities?
No, it just started while I was sitting down
On a scale from 1 to 10, how bad is the pain? How much does it affect your function?
It's about an 8 out of 10, and I'm having trouble catching my breath
Have you noticed any other symptoms along with this?
Yes, I'm feeling nauseous and I'm sweating a lot
Have you experienced any dizziness, fever, or trouble breathing?
I'm having trouble breathing, yes. No dizziness or fever though
Do you have any existing medical conditions?
I have high blood pressure and diabetes
Have you ever had surgery?
No, never had surgery
Are you taking any medications? Any allergies to medications?
I take lisinopril for my blood pressure and metformin for diabetes. No allergies
Do you smoke, drink, or use recreational drugs? Who do you live with?
I quit smoking 5 years ago. I have a drink occasionally. I live with my wife
Does anyone in your immediate family have a history of heart problems, cancer, or diabetes?
My father had a heart attack when he was 60, and my mother has diabetes
